A_contaminated_stem_loop.verdict: CONFIRMED as OLD-RUN bug; ALREADY FIXED in current code (0fcd8c5)
A_contaminated_stem_loop.code_path: _stem_reject_reason (token-containment) -> chapter_integrity_sweep step 5 -> targeted_retry stem fill -> merge stem write
A_contaminated_stem_loop.log_evidence: [SWEEP] q3: stripped contaminated stem ... [RETRY] blocked contaminated stem for q3 ... still stem-missing (round 1 AND 2) ... [RESCUE] page 14: q4 -> 0 field(s) filled ... [GATE] missing_stem q4/q10
A_contaminated_stem_loop.root_cause: solutions RESTATE question-shaped stems; the >=80% token-containment rule flagged good short stems as contaminated; the merge/stem-conflict resolver then let contaminated solution-prose replace a valid stem; retry re-asked the same pages and the guard blocked the same text every round -> dead-end.
A_contaminated_stem_loop.current_fix: _stem_reject_reason narrowed (declarative/>250-char only); merge never lets a contaminated stem replace a valid one; targeted_retry switches to a STEM-REGION-ONLY prompt after one block; Q-pass skipped on pure-solution windows (upstream source) with 1-page cross-section overlap at the Q/S boundary.
A_contaminated_stem_loop.final_output_impact: VERIFIED from log: ch1 q4/q10, ch2 q25, ch7 q1/q23-26, ch11 q1/q17, ch16 q2/q10, ch21 q1, ch23 q10 exported stem-less (export-gate missing_stem). These were final-output damage in the OLD run.
